Package de.hof.dms.service

Class DepartmentService

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.service.DepartmentService
@Service @Profile("!no-mongo") public class DepartmentService extends Object
Manages the application's department registry (MongoDB departments collection) and the assignment of departments to Keycloak users.

The normalized department code is the value carried by Keycloak user attributes, JWT department claims, and folder/document ACLs, so it is immutable after creation and a department cannot be deleted while any of those still reference it — deactivation is the supported alternative. The default department ITDLZ is seeded idempotently at startup.

  • Method Details

    • seedDefaultDepartmentOnStartup

      @EventListener(org.springframework.boot.context.event.ApplicationReadyEvent.class) public void seedDefaultDepartmentOnStartup()
      Seeds the default ITDLZ department once the application is up. Failures are logged instead of aborting startup (e.g. while MongoDB is still unavailable); scripts/mongo-init.js seeds the same department on a fresh database, so both paths converge.

    • ensureDefaultDepartment

      public void ensureDefaultDepartment()
      Inserts the default department if it does not exist yet. Safe to call repeatedly.

    • listDepartments

      public List<DepartmentResponse> listDepartments()

    • createDepartment

      public DepartmentResponse createDepartment(CreateDepartmentRequest request)
      Creates a new department from the request, normalizing the code and rejecting duplicates.
      Throws:
      ApiException - 400 for a missing or malformed code, 409 for a duplicate

    • updateDepartment

      public DepartmentResponse updateDepartment(String code, UpdateDepartmentRequest request)
      Updates a department's display name and/or active flag. The code itself is immutable because documents, folders, and ACLs reference it by value.
      Throws:
      ApiException - 400 for a blank display name, 404 when the code is unknown

    • deleteDepartment

      public void deleteDepartment(String code)
      Deletes a department that nothing references anymore. While users, folders, documents, or ACLs still carry the code, deletion is rejected and the department should be deactivated instead.
      Throws:
      ApiException - 404 when the code is unknown, 409 while still referenced

    • assignUserDepartment

      public void assignUserDepartment(String userId, AssignDepartmentRequest request)
      Assigns a department to a Keycloak user (or removes the assignment for a blank value) by updating the user's department attribute. Only existing, active departments may be assigned.
      Throws:
      ApiException - 400 for an unknown department, 409 for an inactive one, 404 when the Keycloak user does not exist
